lifetime and its consumer's contract. Every entry below is a column where a

mitigated.reason: Stores our own expiring URLs inside message bodies, but EVERY reading path re-mints: markdown images through ImageBlock -> useRemintableSrc -> recognizeOurFileUrl, and media blocks through buildMediaSource, which recovers the file_id from the URL and hands the handler a durable file_id source. No user-visible break. NOT auto-healed because message bodies are the conversation record — rewriting them edits what was said, which is Arman's call, not an agent's.
Holds our own expiring URLs, but the only render path recovers the file_id first and renders <InlineMediaRef>, which mints fresh.
An expiring convenience copy stored ALONGSIDE the durable file_id on the same row. No consumer depends on it resolving — the extension builds its URL from file_id and downloads bytes by file_id.
Workflow node I/O carrying our own expiring URLs for generated office documents. Rendered through the file handler, which re-mints from the recoverable file_id.
mitigated.consumer: features/workflows node I/O rendering via the file handler.

mismatch_open.reason: THE ONE REAL MISMATCH. A note is anon-shareable: platform.shareable_resource_registry exposes `content` in note.public_columns, and app/(public)/s/[token]/SharedResourceView.tsx:238 renders it through MarkdownRenderer with no session. An anonymous recipient cannot re-mint, so an embedded own-signed image goes dark once the signature expires. NOT auto-healed: the only durable ref for a private embedded image is a permanently public URL, and publishing a user's private asset to make a scan pass is a data-exposure incident. Needs Arman's decision — publish those assets, or add token-scoped minting to the share lane.
